pages.text: Production workers are WIP in this compatibility mod, for now Baker, Stonesmelter, Sifter, Composter, Fletcher, Carpenter are compatible. More of the workers will be made compatible in future updates

pages.title: The Request system
pages.text: Each crafter makes processed goods on demand via the Request system.$(br)Requests are automatically created by other citizens when they need items for their own jobs (such as the builder requesting blocks). $(br)You can also create requests manually using the $(thing)Postbox$(). $(br)Once the requested good is produced a currier will pick it up and deliver it to it's destination.$(br)Ongoing requests can be viewed using the clipboard.
